tail:
**Batch 92 authoring is complete.** The 19 Step 1 records contain 12 `ready` items and 7 `escalated` items. The escalations retain their full claims; they identify the missing proofs for grid-move generation, multipointed analytic foundations and invariance, filtered commutation/stabilization, and the grid-to-HFK comparison, plus the two dependent B claims.

I corrected the full filtered square-zero argument: there are \(n\) horizontal and \(n\) vertical thin annuli, and each \(U_i\) occurs twice, so the terms cancel over the multivariable ring. This matches the filtered grid-complex treatment in [*Grid Homology for Knots and Links*, Ch. 13](https://web.math.princeton.edu/~petero/GridHomologyBook.pdf). The multipointed \(V^{\otimes(j-1)}\) factor is recorded separately for the fully collapsed complex, following [MOS, Proposition 2.3](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0607691).

The assigned design links at `plan-knot-theory-track.md` L1139 and L1141 point to KT-38. The current KT-39 block at L1146–1179 controls; I recorded that conflict and its resolution in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-92.notes.md).

Scoped checks pass: content policy 19/19, strict proof contracts 19/19, proof layout 19 items with 35 steps and 0 defects, coverage 38 results with 0 errors or warnings, and source fetch 5/5. The run-wide dependency calculation reports 151 errors elsewhere in the run and 0 for batch 92; its correct level for the pointed-invariance item is 4, including its level-3 batch-59 supplier.

One escalation record was written before that level correction. Its dependency IDs and blocker reason remain correct, but its hash is stale. I left it untouched rather than overwrite an escalation; the owner must refresh it during repair or recertification.

The live run remains owner-held at Step 1. Its latest status reports 39/109 covered and an unrelated malformed prerequisite in [lem-link-peripheral-longitude-word-from-diagram.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-link-peripheral-longitude-word-from-diagram.md), outside this batch. I did not change that item or the run state.

The batch artifacts are in the [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-92.pages.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-92.proof-contracts.json), [coverage ledger](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-92.coverage.json), and [cross-batch dependencies](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-92.cross-batch-dependencies.json).
